purpose: Independent practice of E2.2 — comparing mass and capacity.
student_learning_goal: I can compare and order objects by mass and capacity.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare and order objects by mass and capacity.
header.character_watermark: Roo balancing two objects in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Number 4 objects from lightest (1) to heaviest (4).
parts.visual_layout: 4 objects in a row (cotton ball, marble, brick, eraser). Beside each: a number box.

image_placeholders.description: 4 objects in a row for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. From left: cotton ball, marble, brick, eraser. Each ~1.2in. Beside each, an empty number box.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_MASS at Part 1: instructions ask the child to order by mass. Keywords name the attribute and comparison endpoints.

parts.answer_key: Cotton ball=1, eraser=2, marble=3, brick=4 (typical) — accept reasonable orderings.

parts.student_instructions: Number 4 cups from smallest (1) to largest (4) capacity.
parts.visual_layout: 4 cups of varied size in a row. Beside each: a number box.

image_placeholders.description: 4 cups in a row for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Sizes from left: medium, tiny, large, small. Each cup outlined; the relative sizes clear. Beside each, an empty number box.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_CUPS at Part 2: instructions ask the child to order by capacity. Keywords name the visual element and attribute.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 3 things in your kitchen. Order them by mass OR capacity.

image_placeholders.description: Three numbered rows for a Grade 1 worksheet. Each: '1: ___', '2: ___', '3: ___' for the child to write objects in order.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_ROWS at Part 3: instructions ask the child to order kitchen objects. Keywords name the attributes.

parts.answer_key: Any 3 kitchen items in valid order.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find something heavier than a book.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation artifact. Use Part 1 as the formative signal — children who order by feel/balance not by sight.
